summary: Iteration 16 (Candidate Dashboard premium redesign) fully tested. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed — GET /candidate/applications returns company_logo + job_location on every item; PUT /auth/change-password rejects wrong old password (400), succeeds (200), invalidates old JWT (pwd_reset_at → 401 on /auth/me), old password login fails, new password login succeeds; regression endpoints /candidate/stats, /candidate/recommendations, /cv-professional/my-cvs, /candidate/saved-jobs/ids, /candidate/career-profile all 200; budi password RESTORED to password123 (verified via login 200). Frontend (Playwright, real preview URL): budi login → /candidate/dashboard renders hero ('Halo, Kenan'), 5 stat cards with real numbers (Total 4, Diproses 0, Interview 1, Diterima 0, Ditolak 0), 4 recent applications with logo/lokasi/status badges, 8 recommendations, donut chart + legend, completion ring 95% consistent with sidebar CTA (bar width 95%), CV Aktif 'CV Budi'. All 11 sidebar links navigate to correct route without broken pages. Topnav search 'kasir' → /jobs?q=kasir, find-jobs → /jobs, avatar dropdown opens (Profil/Pengaturan/Logout). /candidate/settings change-password UI flow: password123 → kenan456 → redirect to /login with success toast; restored kenan456 → password123 successfully (final backend login 200). /candidate/help: 3 links have correct href (/hubungi-kami, /tentang-kami, /). Bookmark toggle on recommendation works (no error). Recent-application click → /candidate/applications. Responsive: mobile 390px hamburger opens drawer (21 menu items + CTA), drawer-close-btn closes, NO horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390); tablet 768px no overflow. Role regression: demo@perusahaan.com → /company/dashboard uses OLD layout (no sidebar-profile-mini); admin → /admin/jobs loads OLD admin sidebar. Empty state (registered TEST_new{ts}@example.com): stats show 0, no-applications-yet + CTA rendered, cv-empty rendered, stats-empty rendered, completion 0%.

issues: Minor visual flicker: when navigating from dashboard to /candidate/profile, sidebar-completion-bar briefly shows 0% during route transition/re-fetch before settling to 95%. Consider caching career-profile completion in a global store/context to avoid re-fetching on every layout mount.
